description: Cross-language golden fixture for CommandResult wire encoding (pkg/state/session_commands.go's CommandResult, returned by POST /api/v2/session-commands). pkg/server/routes_state_v2_test.go's TestCommandResultWireMatchesFixture posts a request that deterministically reproduces this exact response through the REAL route handler; web/src/state/v2/wireCodec.test.ts's matching test decodes the same 'wire' bytes with decodeCommandResult and asserts the result equals 'decoded'. Both sides must agree that 'ref' is a canonical STRING on the wire (SessionRef.MarshalJSON) and an OBJECT once decoded (SessionRef from types.ts).
